Ui.SourceCodeLabel: View the FluentLocalizer source code on GitHub
Ui.Tagline: Localization that reads like your code.
Ui.HeroDescription: Start with a key, add arguments and choose a culture when needed. FluentLocalizer retrieves the template, applies plural and select rules, and returns the message to display.
Ui.HeroVisual: A C# example that uses the Fluent API to format a greeting in English, Italian, French, German and Spanish.
Ui.FeaturesDescription: From a one-word label to a sentence that agrees in number and gender, every message is a template you can read, review and translate. No .resx files, no string concatenation.
Ui.FluentDescription: Get, WithArg, Pluralize, Resolve: every call says what it does, so a translation is as easy to review as the code around it.
Ui.NuanceDescription: Each language’s template defines its plural and select rules. Your code supplies the data without handling grammatical variants with if statements.
Ui.CultureDescription: Requests use CurrentUICulture automatically. Choose another culture for a single call; JSON stores handle fallback from en-GB to en and then to the default language.
Ui.ExtendDescription: Implement the two methods of ITranslationStore to read from any source, or use the ready-made JSON stores and the dependency injection package.
Ui.WorkflowDescription: Store one template per language. At runtime, pass the values and, if you need to, a culture. FluentLocalizer picks the template, applies that language's rules and returns the final text.
Ui.AddNeeded: Add the rest when you need it.
Ui.PackagesDescription: Three NuGet packages: the core provides the translation API; add storage and dependency injection support as your application needs them.
Ui.CoreDescription: The translator, the fluent builder, ICU message formatting, options and the ITranslationStore contract.
Ui.StorageDescription: JSON catalogs from the file system, embedded resources or HTTP, with culture fallback.
Ui.IntegrationDescription: One-call registration with Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection, including options and logging.
Ui.Versions: Versions match the packages declared in this repository.
Ui.Experiment: Write a template and switch cultures to see how FluentLocalizer formats the message in your browser.
Ui.NotFoundHelp: The link may be outdated. Return to the overview or open the playground to test templates.
Ui.PlaygroundDescription: Write a template for each language, set the arguments and check the result in your browser using the FluentLocalizer engine.
Ui.ExampleHelp: Pick a pattern, then adapt it for each language.
Ui.TabsHelp: Each language has its own template. Select a tab to edit it and preview the result; changes in the other tabs are kept.
Ui.TemplateHelp: Use `'{name}'` for values, `'{quantity, plural, ...}'` for counts and `'{gender, select, ...}'` for variants.
Ui.EmptyArguments: No custom arguments yet. Add one to fill a placeholder such as `'{name}'`.
Ui.Name: Name
Ui.PreviewEmpty: The {culture} message will appear here as you type.
Ui.MemoryStore: Templates come from an in-memory `ITranslationStore`, and formatting runs entirely in WebAssembly: nothing leaves your browser.
Ui.ExploreDocs: Install the packages, connect a store and resolve your first message in minutes.
Ui.WriteTemplate: Write a template for this language to see its output.
Ui.OtherBranch: Add an other branch: plural and select use it when no other case matches.
Ui.NameRequired: Give each custom argument a name before using it.
Ui.DuplicateArgument: Argument “{name}” is duplicated or reserved for quantity and gender.
Ui.InvalidNumber: Argument “{name}” needs a valid number (use a dot for decimals).

Ui.ApiDescriptionStoreJson: Every public type, constructor, overload, property and enum value of `FluentLocalizer.Store.Json`, with signatures, defaults, return values and the exceptions they can throw. Version numbers refer to this package, which is released independently of Core.

Ui.ApiPackageCore: Translator, fluent builder, options, logging and the store contract. Every other package depends on it.
Ui.ApiPackageJson: JSON translation stores for the file system, embedded resources and HTTP, with culture fallback.
Ui.ApiPackageDi: Registers the translator and its store with Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.

Ui.ChangelogDescription: Every release of the FluentLocalizer packages, newest first. Core (`FluentLocalizer` and its dependency injection extensions) and each store have their own version numbers and are released separately.
Ui.ChangelogInitial: First release of these packages: every public API is new.
Ui.ChangelogLanguage: Like the API reference, release notes are in English. Links lead to the guides and to the API reference of each version.
